answer: Registration is throttled by a public beacon rather than by price. At each epoch's dawn, the beacon's random output draws only 20 new seats from the applicant queue, and every queued applicant must solve one fresh 10-minute judgment task per epoch to stay eligible. A drawn seat then climbs three ledges of 8 epochs each, doing graded work at 25%, 50% and 75% weight before full weight. 500 fakes would take every admission for 25 epochs and owe 12,000 seat-epochs of real graded work, paid even if never caught.
